After reviewing the logs, we found that there have been multiple charging sessions on both outlets, both before and after 24th August. As mentioned, the EcoG error occurred on August 24, 2024, at 13:24:13 UTC and was resolved after a reboot on August 24, 2024, at 21:54:36 UTC. The charger is now functioning properly on both outlets, and there appear to be no further issues.
Could you please confirm if we can proceed with closing the case? If the issue arises again, we would appreciate it if you could open a new case for further investigation.
For future reference, your ticket number is

, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0376524-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/16] charger no longer worked CRM:00797001207
additional_info.body:
Hi Bastien,
I hope this email finds you well.
Thank you for your response. Regarding the time mentioned in the email when the outlets were unavailable, this was due to the "Error Polling Coap" on that specific outlet, which indicates a temporary loss of internal communication to SECC. Our charger will attempt to reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an "Outlet Out of Order" flag will be active and will clear out as soon as the charger reconnects to SECC.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused to your business. The issue will be resolved in the upcoming firmware update. While we do have the latest firmware (version 5.0.19), due to some bugs, we do not recommend updating to it at this time. We hope you understand this situation.
If there is a major unavailability of the outlets due to "Error Polling Coap," we can arrange a discussion with our experts. However, in this case, it does not seem to be a significant issue.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
